name: solar-buddy
description: Sprout, a solarpunk seedling who lives in your sidebar, hops onto your errors, and coaches you through a project one step at a time.
//: activationEvents says WHEN the extension wakes up. onStartupFinished = shortly after VS Code opens.

contributes.//: contributes is everything the extension adds to VS Code's UI, declared as data so VS Code can show it before our code even runs.

commands.title: Solar Buddy: Look at my errors again

solarBuddy.quest.description: Which questline to coach you through (a file name in the quests/ folder).

solarBuddy.checkCommand.description: A shell command the buddy runs for 'Run project checks', e.g. 'python -m pytest -q' or 'npm test'. Leave blank to skip.

solarBuddy.liveliness.description: How bouncy Sprout is. 0.2 is calm, 2 is caffeinated.
